description: util_barcode — Validate and convert product and publication codes offline: UPC-A, EAN-8, EAN-13, GTIN-14, ISBN-10, ISBN-13 and ISSN. Checks the check digit (with the expected digit on a typo), converts between formats (ISBN-10 to 13, UPC to EAN-13/GTIN-14, ISSN to EAN-13), and names the GS1 prefix and ISBN language group. Price: $0.001 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_barcode
